typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{SensorID,EquipmentID,Timestamp,Temperature,Pressure,SpeedRPM,Vibration} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['bronze/scada/**/*.csv']) ~> BronzeSCADASource
BronzeSCADASource derive(SourceTimestamp = toTimestamp(Timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
		Temperature = round((toDecimal(Temperature) - 32) * 5/9, 2),
		Pressure = toDecimal(Pressure)) ~> CleanseAndStandardize
CleanseAndStandardize split(Temperature <= 150 && Temperature >= 0 && !isNull(SensorID),
	disjoint: false) ~> QualityGate@(ValidData, BadData)
QualityGate@ValidData sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	umask: 0022,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		SensorID,
		EquipmentID,
		Timestamp,
		Temperature,
		Pressure,
		SpeedRPM,
		Vibration,
		SourceTimestamp
	)) ~> SilverSink
QualityGate@BadData sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	umask: 0022,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		SensorID,
		EquipmentID,
		Timestamp,
		Temperature,
		Pressure,
		SpeedRPM,
		Vibration,
		SourceTimestamp
	)) ~> QuarantineSink
